A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ALL-DIFF constraint is not limited to finite domains and can be used to model and propagate constraints on any type of variable that can be represented in a finite way.
the propagator is a generalization of the domain consistency propagator for the All-Different constraint to the case of variables whose domains are sets of tuples of integers.
the ALL-DIFF constraint can be used to prune the domains of any variable whose domain can be represented as an integer domain.

the same propagator can be used for all of these domains, with only minor modifications to the code.
the ALL-DIFFERENCE propagator can be generalized in a straightforward way to a large class of finite domains.
